author: (Stimpson, 1859)

note.en: A swimming crab with iridescent colours that lives on mud, sand and shell bottoms; here it is known only from one 1971 museum specimen, and it is not a crab people target.
note.es: Una jaiba de colores iridiscentes que vive en fondos de fango, arena y conchuela; aquí se conoce solo por un ejemplar de museo de 1971 y no es una jaiba que la gente busque.

evidence: GBIF: UM-RSMAS museum specimen (1971), Caribbean Costa Rica

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Caribbean Costa Rica and Bocas del Toro
Williams 1984, Marine Decapod Crustaceans of the Carolinas (sizes as cited in a Brazilian Portunidae study, Nauplius)

recWhy: Only elsewhere on the coast or Bocas del Toro: GBIF: UM-RSMAS museum specimen[^4], Caribbean Costa Rica.

marks.en: Swimming crab with a flattened shell, paddle-like back legs and an iridescent sheen.
marks.es: Cangrejo nadador con caparazon aplanado, ultimas patas como remos y brillo iridiscente.
